body: Where enterprise knowledge becomes specialised AI, combining proprietary data, processes and domain expertise to build models that deliver lasting business value.
Products to explore. Stories to enter. Experiences to live with all the senses, in a space that transforms thanks to AI and allows interaction with its content.
A global, scalable and real-time platform to orchestrate vehicle logistics and support more integrated, connected and data-driven processes.
A program for a multinational Oil & Gas company, based on defining a new Cloud Operating Model, to improve key elements from the customer’s existing Cloud Platform.
How to scale neural models to cut down response time.

As of 30 June 2026, Assets under Management (AUM) increased by approximately €135 billion compared with Q2 2025, representing a 14% growth. Find out more in the extract from e*finance Wealth Management Reply's Quantitative Observatory.
How we set up the framework for the bank’s rapid and game-changing move to public cloud, while also establishing new ways of working and new architectural and security principles.

Please Don't Buy is a Twinset initiative that promotes the rental of clothes directly from the manufacturer. Retail Reply has designed an online and in-store experience, guiding the client through every step of the project.
Engage with our network of experts
